scope: Project balance and identity bindings for source-compiled representative R actions; not complete original characters or abilities.

adaptation_policy.clock: One original action unit maps to 1/60 project seconds; original FPS is not verified.
adaptation_policy.geometry: All three profiles use one uniform scale of 0.5; source negative Y becomes cast-facing forward, source X becomes its orthogonal direction.
adaptation_policy.damage: Project total damage and cooldown, not original multipliers or gauge costs. Original coefficient ranges stay in action_profiles.json.
adaptation_policy.movement: Free movement remains enabled; original StopBall is not replayed.
adaptation_policy.conditions: No leader abilities, character abilities, rank progression, or unimplemented source instructions are inferred.
